description: Reads the Google Maps results for a search from a point and lays them out side by side, with how often each category is used. Use it to see who wins a local search and why, or to find competitors. withDetails opens each profile for the fields the result list does not show. It works in the user's own Chrome through the Local SEO extension, opening Google Maps in a background tab, and fails with a message saying how to connect when the extension is not connected. Nothing is written to Google. Returns results (surface, query, from, readAt and the ranked list), rows (position, sponsored, name, ids, primaryCategory, secondaryCategories, rating, reviewCount, photoCount, website, phone, claimed, address, distanceKm from the point searched from, straight line to one decimal; each null when not read or not known), categoryFrequency (category, usedBy, asPrimary, share 0-1 of rows with known categories), detailsRead and truncated (stopped at max while Maps had more). Each result has position (1-based, ads not counted), sponsored, name, ids (placeId, cid, kgId, featureId, each null when Maps did not expose it), primaryCategory, rating, reviewCount, address and location (the place pin {lat, lng}), each null when the list did not show it.

max.description: The most results to read, 1 to 120. Defaults to 20.

near.description: Where the search is seen from: {lat, lng}, or a place name such as "West Nyack, NY" that is looked up in Maps. Defaults to Maps' own view, which is usually the user's location.

query.description: The search as a customer types it into Maps, such as "emergency plumber".

withDetails.description: Open each result's profile for its secondary categories, photo count, website, phone and claimed state; slow, a few seconds per result. Defaults to false, which leaves those fields null.

name: local_scan
title: Scan local results
